data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was $46.378m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net favourable development on prior years (primarily the 2022 underwriting year) totalling approximately $9.079m (a ~19.6% release of opening reserves), driven by favourable claims development / IBNR recalibration. No specific named catastrophe events are identified as driving the prior year movement in the report.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts in the report are presented rounded to the nearest thousand (values in the tables are $'000). Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding prior year column). No explicit note labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' in gross terms was found; prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2024 and 2023) and comparing the 2022 current estimate to the previous diagonal. The result is therefore a calculated figure (confidence 0.8). A Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) of 2022 & prior was executed post year-end (1 Jan 2025) which crystallises results for those years and may affect comparability, but this occurred after the reporting date.
